subject: Dodge does not work in gropuped line template?

messages.author: 8920bd0e9063a6ef
messages.subject: Dodge does not work in gropuped line template?
parts:
Possible bug. When I add error bars to a grouped line I would like to dodge the error bars so that they are not overlapping. The ‘errorbar’ menu has a box for position and a there is a drop-down menu which has identity as default but also ‘dodge’ as a choice. Dodge takes width as an argument and when I enter any width value and apply it plots but there is no change in the position of the error bars, they don’t ‘dodge’. When I run it there is no error message. Still, no dodging occurs.

Could somebody explain what I am doing wrong or help with a workaround?
